relevance.rationale: WRONG JOIN, and the most extreme in the slice - report loudly. The seeded id was wald1984, i.e. Wald's 1984 textbook 'General Relativity' (DOI 10.7208/chicago/9780226870373.001.0001). This document is a Physical Review Letters article: 'Ultraviolet Completion of the Big Bang in Quadratic Gravity', Liu, Quintin and Afshordi, PRL 136, 111501 (2026), received 4 Nov 2025, published 18 Mar 2026. It is not a textbook, not by Wald, and postdates the seeded entry by forty-two years; the opaque filename 6gtx-j455 gave the matcher nothing to work with. No registered key matches: grep of folio/schema/references.ts for 'Afshordi', 'Quintin', 'quadratic gravity' and '111501' returns nothing. Set id to null. Consequence for the wald1984 key: its three citation sites (lean/QOU/MathlibExt/MonoidalCalcVar.lean:41,109 citing 'Theorem 4.3.1' and Sec. 4.3 for the Einstein equations, and lean/QOU/QuantumObservableUniverse/GaugeTheory.lean:197) have NO uploaded source backing them - the ledger row that appeared to verify wald1984 was verifying a different document entirely, so those locators remain unchecked. Verdict undetermined for this PDF: its own relevance (a quantum quadratic-gravity inflationary scenario, asymptotic freedom in the UV, a predicted minimum tensor-to-scalar ratio of 0.01) has not been assessed and is well outside the fronts I inspected.

proposedActions.rationale: Correct the ledger identification so this file stops standing in for Wald's textbook, and record that the wald1984 citations at MonoidalCalcVar.lean:41,109 and GaugeTheory.lean:197 are therefore still unverified against any source in the repo.
